name: DojiTrader
summary: DojiTrader is an Expert Advisor that identifies Doji candlestick patterns to generate trade signals. It enters positions when a Doji pattern forms at potential reversal zones, suggesting market indecision and impending direction change. The EA automates trade execution based on this single candlestick pattern with configurable parameters for pattern detection and risk management.
summary_zh: DojiTrader是一个基于十字星（Doji）K线形态的交易EA，当十字星出现在潜在反转区域时生成交易信号，暗示市场犹豫和即将到来的方向变化。该EA基于这一单一K线形态自动化执行交易，并提供可配置的形态识别和风险管理参数。
strategy_analysis: DojiTrader策略的核心概念是利用十字星K线形态识别市场犹豫状态，这种形态通常出现在趋势反转或延续的关键位置。入场条件为检测到标准的十字星形态（开盘价与收盘价几乎相等，上下影线较长），可能结合趋势背景或支撑阻力位进行过滤。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，或等待反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA可能提供固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，EA通过可配置的止损设置控制单笔风险，但纯粹依赖单一K线形态可能在震荡行情中产生大量虚假信号，需要额外的趋势过滤机制来提升胜率。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of DojiTrader strategy is to identify market indecision through the Doji candlestick pattern, which typically appears at key reversal or continuation points. Entry conditions involve detecting a standard Doji pattern where the open and close prices are nearly equal with relatively long upper and lower shadows, potentially filtered by trend context or support/resistance levels. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing may offer fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management relies on configurable stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk, but relying purely on a single candlestick pattern can generate numerous false signals in choppy markets, requiring additional trend filtering mechanisms to improve win rates.

parameters.name: DojiMaxBody
parameters.description: 十字星最大实体大小（点数）
parameters.description_en: Maximum doji body size in points

parameters.name: MinShadowRatio
parameters.description: 最小影线与实体的比率

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔幻编号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: 十字星是经典的反转信号形态，具有明确的技术分析理论支撑
策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调试，适合初学者学习K线形态交易
提供了可配置的形态识别参数，允许用户调整十字星的判定标准以适应不同品种
pros_en: The Doji is a classic reversal signal pattern with solid technical analysis theory backing
The strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and debug, suitable for beginners learning candlestick pattern trading
Configurable pattern recognition parameters allow users to adjust Doji detection criteria for different instruments
cons: 单一K线形态策略在震荡市中容易产生大量虚假信号，胜率可能较低
缺乏多时间框架确认和趋势过滤机制，容易被强势趋势中的假反转信号误导
未考虑市场波动率变化，在低波动和高波动环境下使用相同参数可能导致表现不稳定
cons_en: A single candlestick pattern strategy easily generates many false signals in choppy markets, potentially resulting in a low win rate
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and trend filtering mechanisms, making it susceptible to false reversal signals in strong trends
Does not account for market volatility changes; using the same parameters in low and high volatility environments may lead to inconsistent performance
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如EMA或ADX），仅在趋势方向上交易十字星信号以减少虚假信号
加入多时间框架分析，在高级别确认趋势方向后在中级别寻找十字星入场机会
improvements_en: Add trend filtering indicators (such as EMA or ADX) to only trade Doji signals in the trend direction, reducing false signals
Incorporate multi-timeframe analysis, confirming trend direction on higher timeframes before seeking Doji entry opportunities on intermediate timeframes

risk_points: 单一K线形态缺乏确认机制，连续虚假信号可能导致连续亏损
如果止损设置过小，十字星形态后的短期波动可能频繁触发止损
risk_points_en: Single candlestick pattern lacks confirmation mechanism; consecutive false signals may lead to consecutive losses
If stop-loss is set too tight, short-term volatility after Doji formation may frequently trigger stops
